name: Villar del Olmo (Spain)
description: Vertically divided green and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villar del Olmo (an elm on yellow and a cross on green).
history: Municipal flag of Villar del Olmo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villar del Olmo arms — elm on yellow and cross on green
